run_fairchem_cli: run the fairchem CLI with a YAML config file using the main entry point
run_fairchem_on_slurm: run a fairchem job on a SLURM cluster with or without Ray support
run_fairchem_locally: run a fairchem job locally using torch elastic or a local Ray cluster
load_hydra_config_from_yaml: load and canonicalize a Hydra config from a YAML file with CLI overrides
canonicalize_omegaconf_config: canonicalize an OmegaConf DictConfig by resolving variables and removing unused top-level keys
